status: target requirements, not an admitted artifact or measured budget

deployment_requirements.core: compact reusable recurrent core with explicitly costed bounded attention capability; justified variants allowed
deployment_requirements.expert_weights: ternary coefficients, actual packed LUT execution, declared row scales and activation quantization
deployment_requirements.sensitive_organs: F32 baseline; alternative precision requires its own evidence
deployment_requirements.activation: gated-dReLU existing path; costed ternary gated-SiLU or other variant may be justified without invalid ReLU-skip identities
deployment_requirements.capacity: distinct useful pretrained-informed functions, total n separate from selected k/h/work
deployment_requirements.router: structured/hierarchical candidate; charge query/shortlist/selection/normalization and verify selected IDs plus masses
deployment_requirements.storage: packed-only deployment without mandatory full F32/int8 expert reference copies; charge index/scales/padding/core/tokenizer/workspace
deployment_requirements.interaction: canonical source tokenizer/chat/history/EOS; suitable native ID width; readout and prefill charged
deployment_requirements.admission: fresh donor-relative chatbot behavior and at least50 accepted batch1 IDs/s on same artifact, declared cold/warm/context/thread/hardware
deployment_requirements.scaling: useful large n/RAM, physical DRAM, actual further families/scales including10B/100B as resources permit
